title: No streaming fallback: sverify runs Spark batch queries
description: sverify runs plans as batch SQL on a Spark session (`sverify.spark_engine`). Spark has no streaming engine that hands operations to another one: Structured Streaming is a separate API with its own incremental execution, and sverify does not use it.
reference: The reference has no engines; a fact holds for the engine it was probed on. Spark's batch engine is the only one in question.

evidence.note: Structured Streaming: a separate API on the same engine
